title: RNA extraction from colonial tunicates
author: Marta Wawrzyniak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b33nqqme

steps.title: Prepare and Isolate Colony
steps.instruction: Clean the slide and isolate a cleaned colony composed of approximately 20 zooids.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Freezing
steps.instruction: Transfer the colony to a tube, spin at maximum speed for 00:02:00, remove excess water, and shock-freeze the tube in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Homogenization and Extraction
steps.instruction: Macerate the frozen sample with extraction buffer and phenol:chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of extraction buffer and macerate with a plastic pestle
Add 100 µL more of extraction buffer and 500 µL of 1:1 phenol:chloroform
Mix the tube by inversion a couple of times until cloudy

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate and collect the upper phase.

substeps.instruction: Carefully collect 400 µL of the upper phase into a new tube

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using LiCl and incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 6 M (Molarity) LiCl to the supernatant

steps.title: Pellet Washing and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with LiCl and SC-EtOH solution.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 3 M (Molarity) LiCl
Shake slowly for 00:15:00 at Room temperature on a linear shaker
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of SC-EtOH solution

steps.title: Final Ethanol Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Perform a final ethanol wash and air-dry the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 1 mL of 70% volume Ethanol
Discard the supernatant and place the tubes up-side-down on a paper towel for 00:05:00 to 00:10:00

steps.title: Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet and store.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in RNase-free water (20 µL to 100 µL depending on the amount of pellet)

steps.title: Quantification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA concentration and quality using NanoDrop, capillary electrophoresis, and/or the Bioanalyzer.
